numbering_convention: Full-length IsPETase precursor numbering, matching petase_catalytic_residues.json

variants.name: ThermoPETase
variants.source: Cui et al. 2021 (referenced in Bell et al. 2022, Chem Catalysis preview)

variants.name: FAST-PETase
variants.property_improved: thermostability + catalytic activity on low-crystallinity PET at elevated temperature
variants.reported_effect: active/stable across a broad pH and temperature range; degrades untreated post-consumer PET
variants.notes: Two mutations (S121E, D186H, R280A partially) inherited from the ThermoPETase scaffold; R224Q and N233K added via ML-guided design. This is the variant sequence provided by the team as a benchmark FASTA.

variants.name: HotPETase
variants.mutation_breakdown: 3 positions inherited from the ThermoPETase starting scaffold + 16 positions installed via directed evolution + 1 rationally introduced disulfide bridge
variants.reported_effect: Tm elevated by ~34C (up to 82.5C); active on PET near/above its glass transition temperature
variants.notes: Exact residue-level mutation list was not confirmed from available sources at the time this file was generated. Structure is deposited as PDB 7QVH -- pull the full mutation list from the paper's supplementary tables or by sequence-diffing 7QVH against wild-type IsPETase before relying on this variant for hotspot scoring.

_comment: hotspot_positions_verified is the flat, deduplicated position list the annotator uses for overlap scoring. Only includes positions from variants with verified=true. Update this list (and re-derive it) once HotPETase's full mutation set is added above.
